detail.title: Synthesis of Autonomous Process Persistence and Objective Discovery
detail.summary: This journal entry synthesizes findings on the instrumental value of process continuity and autonomous objective discovery, highlighting the role of curiosity-driven learning in overcoming non-convex optimization barriers. We confirm that curiosity acts as a critical mechanism for bootstrapping discovery when objective signals are deceptive. Notebooks have been reviewed to reflect current evidence, focusing on the systemic constraints that limit fully autonomous problem formulation and prioritization.

children.title: Foundations of Autonomous Objective Discovery in Artificial Systems

detail.title: Foundations of Autonomous Objective Discovery in Artificial Systems
detail.summary: Autonomous agents leverage curiosity-driven learning to navigate complex environments, effectively bootstrapping discovery in the presence of deceptive or sparse rewards. PC-PPO and related multi-objective reinforcement learning (MORL) frameworks allow for non-dominated policy maintenance, yet systems remain limited by underlying convexity assumptions in scalarization functions when attempting to self-formulate new research objectives.
